title: Join PAR at NACS Show 2026: Live Demos, Giveaways, and AI-Powered Retail Insights
summary: Join PAR at NACS Show 2026: Live Demos, Giveaways, and AI-Powered Retail Insights by PAR Technology . Convenience and Fuel Retail . Click to learn more now.
body_markdown:
##### **See PAR Intelligence and Touchpoint in action, test your skills on our golf simulator, and discover how convenience retailers are using AI-powered decision-making, identity resolution, and engagement technology to drive stronger business outcomes.**


### ⛳


**Stop by Booth C5958**


Take your best shot on our golf simulator, enter to win premium prizes, and see how PAR is helping convenience retailers turn intelligence into action.


**Win prizes including:**


- Golf clubs


- Hydro Flasks


- Pukka hats


- JBL speakers


The 2026 NACS Show is where convenience retail leaders come to explore what’s next.


From emerging technologies and shifting customer expectations to new strategies for loyalty, engagement, and growth, the industry’s biggest event is packed with ideas about where convenience retail is headed.


This year, PAR Retail is heading to Las Vegas with a simple mission: helping retailers turn more data into action and more customer interactions into measurable business outcomes.


If you’re attending NACS Show, here’s what you’ll find at Booth C5958 from October 7-9.


### **See AI-Powered Retail Insights in Action**


Retailers have more data than ever before. The challenge isn’t collecting it. It’s knowing what to do with it.


At NACS, we’ll be showcasing how PAR helps convenience retailers bridge the gap between data and action through AI-powered decision-making, customer intelligence, and personalized engagement.


Visitors to our booth will get hands-on demonstrations of:


##### **PAR Intelligence**


See how retailers are using AI to uncover opportunities, prioritize actions, identify performance drivers, and make more informed decisions across their business.


PAR Intelligence helps teams move beyond reports and dashboards to understand what matters most and what actions can drive meaningful results.


##### **Touchpoint**


Explore how retailers are creating more engaging in-store experiences that drive loyalty participation, influence purchasing decisions, and extend customer engagement beyond the pump, app, and point of sale.


Touchpoint helps brands connect with customers at key moments inside the store, turning engagement into measurable impact.


Throughout both experiences, you’ll also see how customer intelligence and identity resolution work behind the scenes to connect customer interactions, provide greater context, and help retailers deliver more relevant experiences.


### **Take Your Best Shot**


Technology isn’t the only reason to stop by Booth C5958.


We’re bringing an interactive golf simulator to the show floor, giving attendees the chance to test their swing, compete with fellow retail leaders, and connect with the PAR team in a fun environment.


And while you’re taking your best shot, you’ll also have the chance to win some great prizes.


Swing by the booth and enter for a chance to win:


- Golf clubs


- Hydro Flasks


- Pukka hats


- JBL speakers


Whether you’re stopping by for a quick conversation or a deeper discussion about AI, customer intelligence, and customer engagement, the golf simulator is the perfect opportunity to take a break from the show floor and connect with the PAR team.


### **Let’s Talk What’s Next for Convenience Retail**


The convenience industry is entering a new era where AI, customer intelligence, and connected engagement strategies are becoming essential competitive advantages.


Throughout NACS, members of the PAR Retail team will be available to discuss the trends shaping the industry and share how retailers are using technology to drive stronger outcomes across loyalty, marketing, customer engagement, and operations.


Whether you’re looking to improve loyalty performance, better understand your customers, create more personalized experiences, or explore how AI can support smarter decision-making, we’d love to connect.


### **See You at Booth C5958**


NACS Show is about discovering new ideas, building new relationships, and finding new ways to grow.


Stop by Booth C5958 to experience live demos, test your skills on our golf simulator, meet the PAR team, and enter for your chance to win golf clubs, Hydro Flasks, Pukka hats, JBL speakers, and more.


**Set the PAR. Then Beat It.** See you in Las Vegas.
